workflows.description: Trace each source through its transformations to the sink and name the output context
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Render a local fixture with the extracted template or sanitizer configuration
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.
One suitable option: A bounded offline functional check of Python and the dependencies needed for this task.

workflows.description: Observe an inert marker interpreted as code by the image's Chromium; a local browser run is offline reproduction, not live proof
prerequisites: Chromium 150 and the agent-browser CLI ship in the sandbox image and run headless as root; drive them through the sandbox shell and record live_reproduction from the browser observation.
